figure: Figure A.4 (Where Should Intelligence Live? placement map)
issue: The 'Inside post-training (build-time)' band (row 5 of 8) has no chapter reference in the right-hand reference column, breaking the one-reference-per-band pattern established by every other band.
evidence: Rendered page inspected at 150 dpi. Right-column labels read, top to bottom: 'Ch18, Ch20' (fleet), 'Ch17-20, Ch24' (agent runtime), 'Ch19, Ch24' (tools), 'Ch22' (test-time search), [no label aligned with 'Inside post-training (build-time)'], 'Ch10' (MoE routing), 'Ch7, Ch8' (attention), 'Ch3, Ch8' (weights). The vertical gap between 'Ch22' and 'Ch10' corresponds exactly to one band height, and no glyph is visible in that gap. The figure's stated purpose is mapping each placement band to where it is treated in the book, so an unlabeled band reads as an omission rather than an intentional blank; if the omission is intentional (build-time being out of the book's serving scope), the figure gives the reader no signal of that.
acceptance_test: Confirm against the figure source whether row 5 carries a chapter pointer. If yes, restore it and re-render. If no, either add the intended reference or add an explicit intentional-omission marker (e.g., an em dash or '—') so all 8 bands resolve, then re-render and verify 8 labels for 8 bands.

issue: The two red in-figure annotation lines ('scope of placement: intelligence shifts up out of the weights / (vertical axis = WHERE it lives: nonexclusive placement choices, not a ranking)' and the color legend 'blue = system-side emphasis · green = model-side emphasis · shade = further from the weights is darker') render noticeably smaller than the band labels and appear to be at or below the 8 pt figure-annotation floor; not measured, flagged for measurement.
evidence: Rendered page inspected at 150 dpi. Relative to the caption body (~9–10 pt) and the white/black band labels, both red lines have visibly smaller cap height. These are figure in-text annotations, so the documented math-subscript exemption does not apply. No pixel measurement was performed in this pass.
acceptance_test: Measure the rendered cap height of both red annotation lines in the built PDF; if below the 8 pt print floor, enlarge to ≥8 pt, re-render, and confirm no overlap with the band block or caption is introduced.

issue: Inconsistent reference notation within the same column: 'Ch17-20, Ch24' uses a hyphenated chapter range while all other entries are comma-separated discrete chapters ('Ch18, Ch20', 'Ch19, Ch24', 'Ch7, Ch8', 'Ch3, Ch8'); a reader cannot tell without inference that 'Ch17-20' means chapters 17 through 20, and the range hyphen should typeset as an en dash if retained.
evidence: Rendered page inspected at 150 dpi; the second row label reads 'Ch17-20, Ch24' with a hyphen, no spaces, while no other label in the column uses a range form. Whether chapters 17–20 are all genuinely about agent runtime was NOT VERIFIED in this pass (other pages not in batch).
acceptance_test: Verify chapters 17–20 all support the 'Inside agent runtime' mapping; then either expand to discrete form ('Ch17, Ch18, Ch19, Ch20, Ch24') or keep the range with an en dash and consistent spacing, and confirm the notation matches whatever range convention the book uses elsewhere.
